body:
# PASTASUS

Overview

PastaSus is a lightweight and highly configurable moderation utility plugin designed for Paper servers using Vulcan AntiCheat.

The plugin provides a fast and simple `/sus` command that allows staff members to quickly view suspicious player activity, Vulcan violations, alerts, and other useful moderation information.

PastaSus is designed for survival, SMP, practice, and network servers that require lightweight moderation tools with full configurability and modern formatting support.

Prerequisites

Paper or compatible forks (1.20 - 1.21+ recommended)
Vulcan AntiCheat

Table of Contents

Features
Commands
Permission Nodes
Configuration
Installation
Credits
License

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ FEATURES ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

```
Vulcan Integration: View player violations directly from Vulcan
Suspicion System: Quickly identify suspicious players
Staff Alerts: Receive configurable anticheat notifications
Auto-Sus Support: Automatically flag players over configurable VL thresholds
Fully Configurable Messages: Customize all plugin messages
Sound Support: Play configurable sounds on alerts and commands
MiniMessage Support: Supports MiniMessage, hex colors, and & formatting
Multiple Display Modes: Send messages in chat, actionbar, or both
Lightweight Design: Minimal performance impact
Real-Time Config Reload: Reload settings without restarting
Colored Console Messages: Styled startup and shutdown console messages
```

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ COMMANDS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

`/sus` - View suspicious players
`/sus reload` - Reload plugin configuration
`/sus alerts` - Toggle staff alerts

Aliases:
/psus
/pastasus

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ PERMISSION NODES ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

pastasus.admin - Access all admin commands
pastasus.use - Use the /sus command
pastasus.alerts - Receive staff alerts
pastasus.reload - Reload plugin configuration

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ CONFIGURATION ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Vulcan Settings

vulcan.enabled - Enable Vulcan integration
vulcan.auto-sus.enabled - Enable automatic suspicious player detection
vulcan.auto-sus.violation-threshold - VL needed for auto-sus

Messages System

messages.prefix - Plugin message prefix
messages.sus-header - Header shown in /sus output
messages.sus-line - Violation line format
messages.reload - Reload confirmation message

Display Settings

display-mode - chat, actionbar, or both

Sound Settings

sounds.enabled - Enable or disable sounds
sounds.sus-command.sound - Sound played on /sus
sounds.alert.sound - Sound played on alerts

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ INSTALLATION ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

```
Download the plugin jar
Place it in your plugins folder
Install Vulcan AntiCheat
Restart your server
Edit config.yml to customize settings
Run /sus reload after making changes
```
